source.spec: NIST FIPS 204, 'Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard', approved 2024-08-13, doi:10.6028/NIST.FIPS.204
source.table2: Parameter sets sets consistent with FIPS 204 Table 2 (Section 5.1); ML-DSA-65 == Dilithium3 parameters.

shared_constants.seed_expansion: (rho, sigma, K) = SHAKE-256(xi || k || l, 128); k and l are single octets, k first (FIPS 204 final keygen derivation; witness-validated 3/3 against NIST ACVP by loader_court.py)
shared_constants.mu_derivation: mu = SHAKE-256(tr || msg, 64), tr = SHAKE-256(pk, 64) (FIPS 204 Section 5.4)
